SERVICE AGREEMENT CONTRACT
This Agreement is entered into as of April 12, 2026, between TechCorp Ltd. (Service Provider) and
Kinsha Abid (Client). The parties hereby agree and accept the following terms and conditions of this
contract.
1. SCOPE OF SERVICES
The Service Provider agrees to deliver document classification and PDF extraction software
services as described in Schedule A.
2. PAYMENT TERMS
Client shall pay the total contract amount of $10,000 in two installments: 50% upon signing this
agreement and 50% upon final delivery.
3. SIGNATURES
Service Provider Signature: ____________________
Client Signature: ____________________
